attractions.name: Monticello
attractions.description: Day trip · about 100 km from Richmond. Thomas Jefferson's mountaintop home and plantation, with guided house tours, gardens, a museum, and seasonal hands-on kids' activities at the Mountaintop Activity Center.

attractions.name: Shenandoah National Park
attractions.description: Day trip · about 150 km from Richmond. Blue Ridge peaks, 500 miles of trails, waterfalls, and the scenic Skyline Drive through the mountains.

attractions.name: Lewis Ginter Botanical Garden
attractions.description: Year-round blooms, a conservatory, and a kids' splash area on 50-plus garden acres.

attractions.name: Maymont
attractions.description: A 100-acre estate in Richmond, Virginia, with the reopened Gilded Age Maymont Mansion, Italian and Japanese gardens, an arboretum, a nature center, a farm, and a wildlife trail.

attractions.name: Science Museum of Virginia
attractions.description: Hands-on science museum in the domed 1919 Broad Street Station, with a giant-screen dome theater and planetarium.

attractions.name: Virginia State Capitol
attractions.description: Capitol building designed by Thomas Jefferson, with free guided tours. Inside is Houdon's life-size marble statue of George Washington.

attractions.name: Riverfront Canal Walk
attractions.description: 1.25-mile downtown walkway along the old Haxall and James River & Kanawha canals, with history markers. Seasonal canal boat rides run from it.

attractions.name: Children's Museum of Richmond
attractions.description: Hands-on children's museum on Broad Street with climbing, play spaces and exhibits for young kids.

attractions.name: Pocahontas State Park
attractions.address: 10301 E State Pk Rd, Chesterfield, VA 23832
attractions.description: Virginia's largest state park, about 7,900 acres just south of Richmond, with lakes, forest trails, biking and boat rentals.
attractions.location: 10301 E State Pk Rd, Chesterfield, VA 23832

attractions.name: Virginia Holocaust Museum
attractions.description: Holocaust museum in a 1920s tobacco warehouse in Shockoe Bottom, founded by survivor Jay Ipson, with exhibits on Lithuanian Jewry and the camps.

attractions.name: Libby Hill Park
attractions.description: Church Hill park overlooking the bend of the James River. The view, like the one from Richmond Hill in England, gave the city its name.

attractions.name: Virginia Beach Wooden Boardwalk
attractions.description: Three-mile, roughly 28-foot-wide concrete oceanfront boardwalk running from 2nd to 40th Streets along the Atlantic, with a separate bike path, shops, restaurants and entertainment. The original 1888 boardwalk was made of wooden planks.

attractions.name: Nauticus and Battleship Wisconsin
attractions.description: A maritime discovery center in Norfolk with deck tours aboard a WWII battleship.

attractions.name: Virginia Aquarium & Marine Science Center
attractions.description: Sharks, sea turtles, seals, and hands-on marine exhibits, open daily 9–5.

attractions.name: First Landing State Park
attractions.description: Cypress swamps, maritime forest trails, and 1.5 miles of Chesapeake Bay beach near the 1607 landing site, with over 20 miles of hiking and biking trails.

attractions.name: Cape Henry Lighthouse
attractions.description: Lighthouse from 1792, the first construction project funded by the federal government, on Fort Story at the mouth of the Chesapeake. Adults need photo ID to enter the base.

attractions.name: Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge

attractions.name: Military Aviation Museum

attractions.location: 1341 Princess Anne Rd, Virginia Beach, VA 23457

attractions.name: Norfolk Botanical Garden
attractions.description: 175-acre garden next to Norfolk airport, with themed gardens, azalea woods and seasonal boat and tram tours.

attractions.name: Virginia Zoo
attractions.description: Day trip · about 25 km from Virginia Beach. 53-acre zoo in Norfolk with giraffes, tigers, orangutans and a small train.

attractions.name: Mount Trashmore Park
attractions.description: City park built on a former landfill: a grassy hill with city views, two lakes, a skate park and the Kids Cove playground.

attractions.name: False Cape State Park

attractions.name: Virginia Beach Surf & Rescue Museum
attractions.description: Small museum in the 1903 life-saving station right on the boardwalk, covering shipwrecks and surf rescues.

attractions.name: Colonial Williamsburg
attractions.description: The world's largest living-history museum, with costumed interpreters and working trades across 301 acres.

attractions.name: Virginia Air & Space Science Center
attractions.description: Interactive flight and space exhibits, a giant-screen IMAX theater, and hands-on aviation and space history displays.

attractions.name: The Mariners' Museum and Park
attractions.description: Home of the USS Monitor Center plus a huge free lakefront park, open daily.

attractions.name: Busch Gardens Williamsburg
attractions.description: European-themed amusement park with rides and roller coasters, live shows, animal encounters, dining, and seasonal festivals like Howl-O-Scream and Christmas Town.

attractions.name: Historic Jamestowne
attractions.description: The original 1607 settlement site, with active archaeology digs and a museum of 4,000-plus recovered artifacts.

attractions.name: Jamestown Settlement
attractions.description: Living-history museum with full-size replicas of the three 1607 ships, a reconstructed fort and a Powhatan village.

attractions.name: Yorktown Battlefield
attractions.description: Site of the 1781 siege where Cornwallis surrendered. Driving and walking tours cover the earthworks, cannons and Moore House.

attractions.name: Colonial Parkway
attractions.description: 23-mile scenic road linking Jamestown, Williamsburg and Yorktown, running along the James and York rivers with pull-offs.

attractions.name: Jamestown–Scotland Ferry
attractions.description: Free car-and-passenger ferry across the James River between Jamestown and Scotland, running around the clock. The crossing takes about 20 minutes.

attractions.name: Virginia Living Museum
attractions.address: 524 J Clyde Morris Blvd, Newport News, VA 23601
attractions.description: Day trip · about 30 km from Williamsburg. Newport News museum of Virginia's native animals and plants, with indoor habitats, an outdoor boardwalk and a planetarium.
attractions.location: 524 J Clyde Morris Blvd, Newport News, VA 23601

attractions.name: York River State Park
attractions.address: 9801 York River Park Rd, Williamsburg, VA 23188

attractions.location: 9801 York River Park Rd, Williamsburg, VA 23188

attractions.name: Leavenworth
attractions.description: Bavarian-style alpine village in the Cascades with themed shops, eateries, and year-round festivals.

attractions.name: Washington State Capitol Campus
attractions.description: Day trip · about 75 km from Seattle. Free 50-minute guided tours of the Legislative Building on Washington's Capitol Campus in Olympia, featuring Tiffany chandeliers and marble from different countries.

attractions.name: Olympic National Park
attractions.description: Day trip · about 100 km from Seattle. Diverse national park spanning alpine mountains, temperate rainforest, and 70 miles of wild Pacific coastline.

attractions.name: Space Needle

attractions.name: Pike Place Market

attractions.name: Seattle Aquarium
attractions.description: Waterfront aquarium with marine mammals, tide-pool touch tanks, and a massive underwater dome.

attractions.name: Museum of Flight

attractions.name: Woodland Park Zoo

attractions.name: Museum of Pop Culture (MoPOP)
attractions.description: Interactive pop-culture museum covering music, film, gaming, and sci-fi exhibits in Seattle.

attractions.name: Chihuly Garden and Glass
attractions.description: Indoor-outdoor exhibit of Dale Chihuly's large-scale glass sculptures at Seattle Center.

attractions.name: Snoqualmie Falls
attractions.description: 270-foot waterfall with a public park, observation areas, trails, boardwalk, and picnic areas.

attractions.name: Museum of Glass
attractions.description: Contemporary glass art museum in Tacoma, WA, known for live glassblowing demonstrations in its Hot Shop and rotating exhibitions.

attractions.name: Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium
attractions.description: Combined zoo and aquarium with Northwest wildlife, polar bears, and sharks.

attractions.name: LeMay – America's Car Museum
attractions.description: Four floors of 250+ classic and vintage cars plus interactive exhibits for all ages.

attractions.name: Pacific Science Center
attractions.address: 200 Sue Bird Ct N, Seattle, WA 98109
attractions.description: Hands-on science center under its landmark white arches at Seattle Center, with a planetarium, tropical butterfly house and dinosaur exhibits.
attractions.location: 200 Sue Bird Ct N, Seattle, WA 98109

attractions.name: Kerry Park
attractions.description: Small Queen Anne hillside park with the classic postcard view of the Space Needle, downtown skyline, Elliott Bay and, on clear days, Mount Rainier.

attractions.name: Ballard Locks (Hiram M. Chittenden Locks)
attractions.description: Working locks between Puget Sound and Lake Union where visitors watch boats raised and lowered, plus a fish ladder viewing room and botanical garden.

attractions.name: Discovery Park
attractions.description: Seattle's largest park, on Magnolia's bluffs, with forest and meadow trails, beaches and the historic West Point Lighthouse with Olympic Mountain views.

attractions.name: Museum of History & Industry (MOHAI)

attractions.name: Kubota Garden
attractions.description: Free 20-acre Japanese-style garden in south Seattle with ponds, waterfalls, stone paths and a red moon bridge.

attractions.name: Gas Works Park
attractions.description: Lake Union park built around the rusting towers of an old gasification plant, with a hill offering skyline views across the lake.

attractions.name: Washington Park Arboretum
attractions.description: Free 230-acre University of Washington arboretum on Lake Washington with woodland trails, collections of trees and the Seattle Japanese Garden.

attractions.name: Fremont Troll
attractions.description: Giant concrete troll sculpture crushing a real Volkswagen Beetle under the Aurora Bridge in the Fremont neighborhood; kids can climb on it.

attractions.name: Northwest Trek Wildlife Park
attractions.description: Day trip · about 75 km from Seattle. Wildlife park in the forested foothills near Eatonville where a tram tour passes bison, elk and moose roaming free, plus bear, wolf and cougar habitats.

attractions.name: Riverfront Park
attractions.description: 100-acre downtown Spokane park along the Spokane River, home to Spokane Falls, a cable car ride over the falls, a historic carousel, and the Pavilion.

attractions.name: Manito Park

attractions.name: Riverside State Park (Bowl and Pitcher)
attractions.address: 9711 W Charles Rd, Nine Mile Falls, WA 99026

attractions.location: 9711 W Charles Rd, Nine Mile Falls, WA 99026

attractions.name: Mount Spokane State Park
attractions.address: 25211 N Mount Spokane Park Dr, Mead, WA 99021

groceries.name: QFC (University Village)

groceries.name: Yoke’s Fresh Market Section

attractions.name: National Museum of American History

attractions.location: 100 Raoul Wallenberg Pl SW, Washington, DC 20024

attractions.name: Smithsonian's National Zoo

attractions.name: Great Falls Park

attractions.description: One of the primary breeding grounds in the Americas for the gorgeous pink Caribbean flamingo.

attractions.name: Lac Bay

attractions.name: Tortola

attractions.description: Small national park on Tortola’s north side protecting the stone windmill of an 18th-century sugar estate, the last windmill standing in the BVI.
attractions.location: Ridge Road, Mount Healthy, Tortola, British Virgin Islands

attractions.address: Cane Garden Bay, Tortola, British Virgin Islands

attractions.name: Parque Almendares (Metropolitan Park of Havana)

attractions.description: Explore local highlights.
